# Forensic Science Simplified

> A comprehensive educational resource covering all major forensic science disciplines, evidence types, and investigation methodologies for law enforcement and criminal justice professionals.

Forensic Science Simplified provides introductory guides to forensic analysis techniques, evidence collection procedures, and courtroom admissibility standards. The site covers both traditional forensic disciplines (fingerprints, DNA, ballistics) and emerging areas (digital evidence, audio/video analysis), serving as a reference for first responders and investigators.

## Key Topics

- Crime Scene Investigation
- DNA Evidence
- Fingerprint Analysis
- Bloodstain Pattern Analysis
- Digital Evidence
- Forensic Evidence
- Evidence Collection
- Audio/Video Analysis
- Firearms Examination
- Toxicology
- Trace Evidence
- Document Examination
- Law Enforcement
- Criminal Justice
- Forensic Investigation

## Core Forensic Disciplines

- [Crime Scene Investigation: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/csi): Overview of crime scene investigation procedures and evidence collection methodologies.
- [DNA Evidence: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/dna): Introduction to DNA analysis and its role in forensic science and criminal justice.
- [Fingerprint Analysis: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/prints): Introduction to fingerprint analysis and biometric identification in criminal investigations.
- [Bloodstain Pattern Analysis: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/blood): Introduction to bloodstain pattern analysis techniques and forensic evidence interpretation.

## Physical Evidence Analysis

- [Firearms Examination: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/firearms): Introduction to ballistics and firearms examination including bullet and cartridge analysis.
- [Trace Evidence: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/trace): Introduction to trace evidence analysis including hair, fibers, paint, and glass.
- [Footwear & Tire Track Examination: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/fwtt): Guide to footwear and tire track pattern evidence analysis in crime scene investigations.
- [Explosives Analysis: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/explosives): Introduction to explosives analysis and forensic investigation of explosive devices.

## Chemical & Toxicological Analysis

- [Forensic Drug Chemistry: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/drugs): Introduction to forensic drug chemistry and controlled substance identification methods.
- [Toxicology: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/tox): Introduction to forensic toxicology and poison detection in medicolegal investigations.

## Digital & Multimedia Evidence

- [Digital Evidence: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/digital): Guide to digital evidence collection and electronic device forensics for first responders.
- [Forensic Audio and Video Analysis: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/av): Introduction to audio and video analysis in forensic investigations using CCTV and surveillance footage.

## Documentation & Expert Testimony

- [Crime Scene Photography: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/photo): Introduction to crime scene photography and forensic documentation for courtroom evidence.
- [Forensic Document Examination: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/docs): Introduction to questioned document examination and fraud detection techniques.
- [Forensic Evidence Admissibility & Expert Witnesses: Introduction](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/legal): Guide to Daubert and Frye standards for forensic evidence admissibility in court.

## Optional

- [Forensic Science Simplified: Funding Statement](https://forensicsciencesimplified.org/statement.html): Funding and attribution statement for Forensic Science Simplified educational project.
